mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and enhances equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in unemployment rate (exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months) signals economic deterioration and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate indicates monetary easing in response to labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early to mid-cycle expansion, strong retail sales growth (RSAFS above 0.5% monthly) supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% and the regime is early to mid-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (growth above 0.3% monthly) reflects robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.3%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.3 percentage points over three months) prompts expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises >0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST falling more than 10% over three months) signals weakening consumer demand and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls >10% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to anticipated monetary tightening, over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly and the labor market is tight (UNRATE < 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
